_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Aircraft Material Supply Readiness Reporting (AMSRR)
summary: AMSRR is a software tool that integrates data fields to provide daily status reports on fleet aircraft material condition, enabling commanders and support managers to identify deficiencies.
use_relationship:
AMSRR is the software tool developed to integrate the required data fields and provide up-line data transfer. This report provides a daily status report that enables supporting commanders to assess current aircraft material condition and rapidly identify significant aircraft and support equipment deficiencies. The report will be utilized by the Chief of Naval Aviation Training Wing Commanders and the Contractor Logistics Support managers that provide maintenance and logistics services. The report identifies the material condition status of fleet aircraft.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended to use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Performance Work Statement (PWS).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The data for each report shall be provided within AMSRR in accordance with the requirements of Paragraph 1.

children.title: The AMSRR report must report material condition
children.content: as of 0800 local. The report must be submitted daily for each normal workday.

children.title: Intended Use Information
children.content: This data will be used by Government and Contractor personnel to improve the usage of Government assets by monitoring operational efficiency, flight operations, contractor performance, aircraft availability, and identification of mission cancellations.
